{"implementation": "def solve(case):
    segments = case['segments']
    budget = case['budget']
    n = len(segments)
    mins = [s['minimum'] for s in segments]
    caps = [s['capacity'] for s in segments]
    sum_min = sum(mins)
    sum_cap = sum(caps)
    if budget < sum_min or budget > sum_cap:
        raise ValueError
    alloc = mins[:]
    remaining = budget - sum_min
    while remaining > 0:
        best_idx = -1
        best_gain = -1.0
        for i in range(n):
            if alloc[i] >= caps[i]:
                continue
            gain = segments[i]['importance'] / (alloc[i] + 1)
            if gain > best_gain or (gain == best_gain and i < best_idx):
                best_gain = gain
                best_idx = i
        if best_idx == -1:
            raise ValueError
        alloc[best_idx] += 1
        remaining -= 1
    by_name = {segments[i]['name']: alloc[i] for i in range(n)}
    total = sum(alloc)
    return {'allocations': alloc, 'by_name': by_name, 'total': total}"}
